grain.process: one row per recorded time coordinate within experiment_key
grain.metrology: one row per experiment_key and spatial X,Y
grain.independent_evaluation_unit: lot/date, not individual time rows or spatial sites

join.orphan_and_blank_keys: retain as excluded with reason; no key inference; no many-to-many join

features.policy: use only exact common channel-name intersection; no filling extra channels
features.units: unverified; do not infer units from channel names

time.absolute_time: unverified; must not treat as 2024 UTC
time.retain: group name date and raw time coordinate separately
time.gap_rule_status: descriptive quality check, not detection threshold
time.gap_handling: retain flags; no interpolation or derivatives/windows across gaps; no OES synchronization until time semantics verified

measurements.primary_candidate: si_etch, a derived metrology quantity, not Yield or ET
measurements.primary_candidate_status: target definition requires review before any experiment
measurements.raw_missing_mask: postox_thickness_nan missing => observed post-etch value unavailable; interpolated value must remain labeled
measurements.preox_thickness: provider interpolated; not all 89 sites independent measurements
measurements.other_outcomes: do not combine 9-point experiment-day and 89-point later measurements as contemporaneous targets

forbidden: different sites of same wafer in train and test
